The binding of Nitrendipine to these calcium channel subunits suggests a mechanism by which it could modulate the activity of Cacnb2, possibly through direct or indirect effects on calcium flux. The varying scores in the paths reflect the strength of the interactions, with the highest scores pointing to the most direct involvement of Nitrendipine in the calcium channel pathway.
